body.x: IRISYS (CEO Seung-Eun Han, www.irisys.co.kr) previewed its iris recognition USB security device, the "LOCKIT USB," at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.

The LOCKIT USB is an upgraded version of USB security device with added iris recognition function. It has a micro camera made by IRISYS within the USB to scan and recognize the user’s iris in real time.

Its iris recognition speed is clocked at 0.5 seconds--currently the fastest in the world. The iris recognition accuracy has been raised by using cutting-edge technology including the ability to differentiate different iris colors between races and prevent potential disturbance from eyelashes.

Additionally, it has an auto lock function when the device is removed from a USB port while the device can be wirelessly connected with a smartphone. IRISYS has assured the devices are designed to make tampering of the USB nearly impossible. The memory storage size comes in 8GB , 16GB, and 32GB.

IRISYS was formed in 2012, specializing in bio recognition solution and has its own algorithm as an iris security company. In addition to its iris recognition LOCKIT USB, iris recognizing mobile applications and other products, it supplies hard drive security, PC security, financial transaction, OPT generators, building security systems using these products and technology.
